message.content: {"mentions":[{"ref":"m1","surface":"文章","occurrence":0},{"ref":"m2","surface":"名目","occurrence":1},{"ref":"m3","surface":"列傳","occurrence":2},{"ref":"m4","surface":"自傳","occurrence":3},{"ref":"m5","surface":"內傳","occurrence":4},{"ref":"m6","surface":"外傳","occurrence":5},{"ref":"m7","surface":"別傳","occurrence":6},{"ref":"m8","surface":"家傳","occurrence":7},{"ref":"m9","surface":"小傳","occurrence":8},{"ref":"m10","surface":"本傳","occurrence":9},{"ref":"m11","surface":"正傳","occurrence":10},{"ref":"m12","surface":"阿Q","occurrence":11}],"relations":[],"alias_proposals":[["m10","m12","這一篇也便是『本傳』，但從我的文章着想，因爲文體卑下，是『引車賣漿者流』所用的話，所以不敢僭稱，便從不入三教九流的小說家所謂『閒話休題言歸正傳』這一句套話裏，取出『正傳』兩個字來，作爲名目，卽使與古人所撰書法正傳的『正傳』字面上很相混，也顧不得了。",10]]}
